1217.cn: 特技车手 Antti 套装

OUTFIT_00_NAME#40.desc_cn: 没人数的清头盔上有多少凹陷，垫肩上有多少刮痕，裤子上有多少裂口，但有一件事是确定的，这幅外套拥有者生命力非常顽强。
OUTFIT_00_NAME#40.desc_en: Who knows how many dents this helmet has seen, how many scrapes the shoulder pads, or tears the pants. One thing is certain, this outfit is a survivor.

OUTFIT_01_NAME#48.desc_cn: 不论这套装来自何方，都是为沙漠之旅精心裁剪过的。此外，围巾还由纯有机羊驼毛制成。
OUTFIT_01_NAME#48.desc_en: Wherever it came from, this outfit seems perfectly  tailored for desert travel.  Even more impressive - the scarf is made from 100% certified organic alpaca wool.

OUTFIT_02_NAME#45.desc_cn: 除了能起到吓唬对手的作用，全身包括的皮革和带有反射的阴影也能把你对小猫咪的爱深藏内心。
OUTFIT_02_NAME#45.desc_en: While perfect for intimidating opponents, the reflective shades and full coverage leather also double as a way to hide your complete love of kittens.

OUTFIT_03_NAME#47.desc_cn: 紧身牛仔裤，检查完成；讽刺对手的上衣、衬衫和领带，检查完成；隐藏你内心忧虑的护目镜，再次检查完成。
OUTFIT_03_NAME#47.desc_en: Skinny Jeans - Check.  Ironic pilots jacket over a shirt and tie - Check.  Goggles to hide your inner sadness - Double Check.

OUTFIT_04_NAME#44.desc_cn: 用来狠狠打击对手的外套。头盔是完美装下你手下败将眼泪的容器。
OUTFIT_04_NAME#44.desc_en: Just the outfit for slaughtering your opponents on the course.  The helmet also doubles as a perfect container for your victim's tears.

OUTFIT_05_NAME#42.desc_cn: 另一个时代的外套，特技人带给你闪亮的色彩和让人不寒而栗的闪电图案，特别能在空转后讲讲落地时吸引粉丝的眼球。
OUTFIT_05_NAME#42.desc_en: An outfit from another time, The Stuntman offers bright shiny colors and commanding lightning bolt styling.  Perfect for distracting your fans while barely landing that backflip!

OUTFIT_06_NAME#41.desc_cn: 准备好进入危险区域了吗？空中肉搏就是完美的外套选择。赶紧带上你所有的激情穿上这套服装吧。
OUTFIT_06_NAME#41.desc_en: Ready to enter the danger zone?  If so The Dogfighter is the perfect outfit.  Comes equipped with all the required straps to contain your excitement.

OUTFIT_07_NAME#43.desc_cn: 特技表演和角斗士搏斗有很多相似之处…除了对手不是狮子…武器也不是利剑…也不会随时有被处决的危险。
OUTFIT_07_NAME#43.desc_en: Trials racing is a lot like gladiator fights... except for the lions... and swords.. and constant threat of execution.

OUTFIT_08_NAME#46.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：完成任务时额外获得20%经验值（无需穿戴完整）
OUTFIT_08_NAME#46.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Gain 20% more XP when completing missions. (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_08_NAME#46.desc_cn: 长久以来被遗忘的奇特外套，袖子上带有“神佛工业”的刺绣图案。
OUTFIT_08_NAME#46.desc_en: A strange outfit from the long forgotten past.  It appears to have the words 'Samsara Industries' embroidered on the sleeve.

OUTFIT_09_NAME#49.desc_cn: 深海探索和摩托骑行 - 完美的组合！
OUTFIT_09_NAME#49.desc_en: Deep sea exploration and motorcycle racing - the perfect combination!

OUTFIT_10_NAME#50.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：完成赛道后经验值增加10%！（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_10_NAME#50.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Gain 10% more XP when completing tracks. (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_10_NAME#50.desc_cn: 为了震惊和威慑！最终成为了反抗的理由。（包含临时纹身）
OUTFIT_10_NAME#50.desc_en: Dress to impress...and intimidate!  Finally become a rebel WITH a cause.  (temporary tattoos included)

OUTFIT_11_NAME#51.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：大转盘获得的宝石+1！（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_11_NAME#51.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: +1 Gems when landing on the Loot Wheel Gem slot. (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_11_NAME#51.desc_cn: 用你无尽的愤怒，将恐惧埋葬到内心的最深处。改变从来不是赶时髦。
OUTFIT_11_NAME#51.desc_en: Strike terror into the hearts of the wicked and smite them with your holy rage!  Crusading has never looked so stylish.

OUTFIT_12_NAME#52.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：点击大转盘式增加该对象的获取概率！（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_12_NAME#52.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Increased section growth when tapping the Loot Wheel! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_12_NAME#52.desc_cn: 连接Facebook并邀请你的好友一起游戏…然后击败他们！只要有了执法者坚固的护甲，即使在最艰难的赛道上也不会被撞出凹痕。
OUTFIT_12_NAME#52.desc_en: Connect with Facebook and invite your friends to the game...THEN CRUSH THEM!  With The Enforcer's rigid body armor even the most painful track endings won't leave a dent.

OUTFIT_13_NAME#53.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：每个检查点+50%金币。（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_13_NAME#53.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: +50% more coins per checkpoint. (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_13_NAME#53.desc_cn: 感到总是被误解，无法被欣赏吗？那你就拥有穿上坏小子外套的权利。保证会让陌生人和粉丝们惊呼！
OUTFIT_13_NAME#53.desc_en: Feeling misunderstood and underappreciated?  Then you'll fit right in wearing The Goon outfit.  Guaranteed to creep out both strangers AND loved ones!

OUTFIT_14_NAME#54.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：减少老虎机冷却时间20%！（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_14_NAME#54.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Reduce slot machine cool-down by 20%! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_14_NAME#54.desc_cn: 还记得我们该如何飞跃骑车吗？好吧我们不知道，但我们却拥有竖直的衣领，那不是我们想要拥有的嘛？
OUTFIT_14_NAME#54.desc_en: Remember how we were supposed to have flying cars by now?  Well we don't, but we do have popped collars, and isn't that what we deserve?

OUTFIT_15_NAME#55.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：加速汽油填补时间33%！（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_15_NAME#55.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Speed-up fuel refill by 33%! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_15_NAME#55.desc_cn: 白金骑士是最令人垂涎欲滴的外套，而且是最具有挑战性的。欢迎来到特技骑行的主赛场，享受这趟旅程吧！
OUTFIT_15_NAME#55.desc_en: The Platinum Knight is the most coveted of outfits, and also by far the most challenging to earn.  Welcome to the major league of Trials riding and enjoy the trip!

OUTFIT_16_NAME#56.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：加速摩托升级速度10%！（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_16_NAME#56.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Speed-up bike upgrades by 10%! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)

OUTFIT_17_NAME#57.desc_cn: 穿上这套服装，你就成为了神秘的国际阴谋家，或者，至少看上去非常非常唬人。但是，有件事情是可以确定的，没人会知道你的真实身份。
OUTFIT_17_NAME#57.desc_en: Turn into an international man of mystery and intrigue by wearing this outfit. Or at the very least look really, really creepy. Either way, one thing is certain: your true identity will remain a secret.

OUTFIT_18_NAME#103.desc_cn: 穿上这套似乎有些笨重的铠甲，加入传奇古代守护者的行列吧。可能包含类似永恒天谴或内心堕落之类副作用。
OUTFIT_18_NAME#103.desc_en: Join the ranks of legendary Guardian Riders with this not-so-convenient armor set. Possible side effects include eternal damnation and corruption of one's soul.

OUTFIT_19_NAME#59.desc_cn: 是时候让你从内心产生对蔬菜的恐惧了，这份外套会让你感受到这一切！疯狂大笑除外。
OUTFIT_19_NAME#59.desc_en: It's about time you put the fear of vegetables in the hearts and minds of all, and this outfit will help you do just that! Maniacal laughter not included.

OUTFIT_21_NAME#58.desc_cn: 每款游戏都需要一名戴着骷髅面具的士兵。这就是我们的士兵。
OUTFIT_21_NAME#58.desc_en: Every game needs to have a soldier with a skull mask.  Here's ours.

OUTFIT_22_NAME#104.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：检查点金币x2。（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_22_NAME#104.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: 2x more coins per checkpoint. (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_22_NAME#104.desc_cn: 半人，半鸟。但无论如何，该套装不会给你飞行能力。要成为一个更棒的骑手，你还得依靠你自己。
OUTFIT_22_NAME#104.desc_en: Half man, half cuckoo. No matter how much you want it, this outfit won't make you a better rider or grant you flight capabilities.

OUTFIT_23_NAME#105.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：PVP筹码商店10%折扣。（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_23_NAME#105.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: 10% discount in PvP Chip Shop! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_23_NAME#105.desc_cn: 最后，别忘了把自己投入这套真正的科尼利厄斯松树套装里！纯正100%未处理野生松树毛制作，你能够在派对上装扮成一只大大的松树！
OUTFIT_23_NAME#105.desc_en: Finally fulfill your furry fantasies with this authentic Cornelius the Squirrel costume!  Being made from 100% unwashed wild squirrel fur means you'll be the most authentic man-sized rodent at the party!

OUTFIT_24_NAME#107.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：大转盘上获得煤炭x2。（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_24_NAME#107.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: 2x Coal Lumps when landing on the Loot Wheel Coal Lump slot. (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_24_NAME#107.desc_cn: 信不信由你，只要对头盔稍作修改，它就成为了完美的登山利器。虽然戴起来也许有些重，但至少你不会因此缺氧。
OUTFIT_24_NAME#107.desc_en: Believe or not, with a little modification a diving helmet makes for excellent climbing gear. It's maybe a bit on the heavy side, but at least you'll never run out of air.

OUTFIT_25_NAME#108.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：大转盘上获得放大镜x2。（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_25_NAME#108.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: 2x Magnifying Glasses when landing on the Loot Wheel Magnifying Glass slot. (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_25_NAME#108.desc_cn: 使用最为狂野和狡猾的材料制作。穿上它，大家都想和你同行，并希望模仿你！
OUTFIT_25_NAME#108.desc_en: Adopt the garments of the wiliest outlaw who ever rode the tundra. With this on everybody wants to be you AND be with you!

OUTFIT_26_NAME#109.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：大转盘获得的木柴x2（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_26_NAME#109.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: 2x Kindling when landing on the Loot Wheel Kindling slot. (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_26_NAME#109.desc_cn: 酷炫的特技人套装可选图案。总之，你的胸毛会暂时帮你保暖的。
OUTFIT_26_NAME#109.desc_en: A cool alternative look for your Stuntman Outfit. After all, your chest hair will only keep you warm for so long.

OUTFIT_27_NAME#106.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：大转盘上获得野人皮毛x2。（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_27_NAME#106.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: 2x Yeti Fur when landing on the Loot Wheel Yeti Fur slot. (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_27_NAME#106.desc_cn: 穿上它，给那些看你不爽的家伙们死亡的恐惧吧。
OUTFIT_27_NAME#106.desc_en: Send chills down the spines of all who oppose you by wearing this fearsome armor.

OUTFIT_28_NAME#110.desc_cn: 每个想要成为山区之王人们心中的梦想套装。趁着天气还没转暖，赶紧穿上它外出骑行吧！
OUTFIT_28_NAME#110.desc_en: Every hipster's prime choice for becoming a legend of the mountains. Get it while it's still cool!

OUTFIT_29_NAME#111.desc_cn: 即使在严寒的条件下，这件外套也能让你感受到温暖！这是任何出没在北极圈内的骑手的不二之选！
OUTFIT_29_NAME#111.desc_en: This outfit will keep you warm even in the harshest of conditions! A must-have item for any aspiring arctic rider!

OUTFIT_30_NAME#112.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：大转盘转到Bronco币获得两倍奖励。（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_30_NAME#112.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: 2x Bronco Bucks when landing on the Loot Wheel Bronco Buck slot. (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_30_NAME#112.desc_cn: 前线不仅仅是男人的世界！用这件美丽而实用的外套装饰你的女性骑手吧！左轮手枪不包含其中。
OUTFIT_30_NAME#112.desc_en: Trials Frontier isn't just a man's world! Spruce up your female rider with this pretty AND practical outfit! Six shooter sold separately.

OUTFIT_31_NAME#113.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：+1碉堡中的对决空位！（外套不需要被装备。）
OUTFIT_31_NAME#113.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Gain +1 free Showdown slots in the Bunker! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_31_NAME#113.desc_cn: 扎根本土，彰显荣耀！慑人的战嚎一定能把那些胆小的牛仔吓破胆！
OUTFIT_31_NAME#113.desc_en: Stick to your roots and display them proudly! Top off with a scary war cry and you'll be sure to scare the chaps off of any aspiring cowboys!

OUTFIT_32_NAME#114.desc_cn: 前线没有约束！摆脱你的束缚，做个自由之人！但你最好还是穿着这套监狱条纹服，并卷土重来。
OUTFIT_32_NAME#114.desc_en: Anarchy in the Frontier! Break free from your chains and ride like a free man! But better hang on to that prison onesie, stripes are making a comeback.

OUTFIT_33_NAME#115.desc_cn: 坏人们要当心了！小胡子治安官已经来到城里！称为希望和正义的象征，或只是让人们开心一下。
OUTFIT_33_NAME#115.desc_en: Bad guys beware! The Sheriff is in  town with a moustache to match! Become a symbol of hope and justice or just lock people up for fun.

OUTFIT_34_NAME#116.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：从大转盘获得特工摩托车蓝图碎片的几率翻倍。（外套无需穿着。）
OUTFIT_34_NAME#116.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Double the chance of getting Agent Bike Blueprint Pieces for the Loot Wheel. (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_34_NAME#116.desc_cn: 和危险分子相处并显出自己的风格！同样能更轻易地从辛迪加手里抢夺蓝图碎片。你值得拥有。
OUTFIT_34_NAME#116.desc_en: Blend in with the bad guys AND look stylish! Also makes it easier to snag Agent Bike Blueprint Pieces from the Loot Wheel. What's not to like?

OUTFIT_34_NAME#145.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：从大转盘获得特工摩托车蓝图碎片的几率翻倍。（外套无需穿着。）
OUTFIT_34_NAME#145.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Double the chance of getting Agent Bike Blueprint Pieces for the Loot Wheel. (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_34_NAME#145.desc_cn: 和危险分子相处并显出自己的风格！同样能更轻易地从辛迪加手里抢夺蓝图碎片。你值得拥有。
OUTFIT_34_NAME#145.desc_en: Blend in with the bad guys AND look stylish! Also makes it easier to snag Agent Bike Blueprint Pieces from the Loot Wheel. What's not to like?

OUTFIT_35_NAME#117.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：摩托车升级速度加快一倍！（外套无需穿着。）
OUTFIT_35_NAME#117.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Speed-up bike upgrades by 50%! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_35_NAME#117.desc_cn: 准备好了，这是一套舒适且带有保护性的外套。同样能够获得黑市同伴在升级摩托车上的帮助。
OUTFIT_35_NAME#117.desc_en: Be prepared for anything with this comfortable, yet protective outfit. Included is a list of black market contacts to help with any future Bike Upgrades.

OUTFIT_35_NAME#146.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：摩托车升级速度加快一倍！（外套无需穿着。）
OUTFIT_35_NAME#146.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Speed-up bike upgrades by 50%! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_35_NAME#146.desc_cn: 准备好了，这是一套舒适且带有保护性的外套。同样能够获得黑市同伴在升级摩托车上的帮助。
OUTFIT_35_NAME#146.desc_en: Be prepared for anything with this comfortable, yet protective outfit. Included is a list of black market contacts to help with any future Bike Upgrades.

OUTFIT_36_NAME#144.desc_cn: 坚决、快速而独立地骑行！这是自由其手的不二之选。
OUTFIT_36_NAME#144.desc_en: Ride hard, ride fast and ride independent! The outfit choice of the truly free rider.

OUTFIT_37_NAME#147.desc_cn: 开枪很容易，但你能比自己的影子还迅速吗？这套套装也许会给你个机会。
OUTFIT_37_NAME#147.desc_en: Shooting is easy, but can you ride faster than your own shadow? With this outfit you just might have a chance.

OUTFIT_38_NAME#148.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：无限汽油！（套装无需装备。）
OUTFIT_38_NAME#148.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Unlimited fuel! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_38_NAME#148.desc_cn: 专为已经拥有一切且不畏惧展示的骑手准备。
OUTFIT_38_NAME#148.desc_en: For the Rider who already has everything and isn't afraid to show it.

OUTFIT_39_NAME#149.desc_cn: 大家都知道鲨鱼太牛逼了，但你知道什么东西更牛逼么？当然是轮子上的鲨鱼！立即下载{c1}《饥饿鲨：进化》{c0}为你的骑手解锁这套饥饿鲨鱼外套，狠狠地给对手一口！
OUTFIT_39_NAME#149.desc_en: Everyone knows that sharks are AWESOME but you know what's even better? Sharks on wheels of course! Download {c1}Hungry Shark Evolution{c0} right now to unlock the Hungry Shark outfit for your Rider and take a bite out of your opposition!

OUTFIT_40_NAME#155.bonus_cn: 大转盘中放出双倍活动点数！（外套无需装备）
OUTFIT_40_NAME#155.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Double Halloween Event Points from the Loot Wheel!  (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_40_NAME#155.desc_cn: 终极减肥配方 - 不挨饿的情况下减去重量！你所需要的只是小瓶人血，一撮纯真孩子的头发和一个邪恶的巫术诅咒 - 这再简单不过了！
OUTFIT_40_NAME#155.desc_en: The ultimate in diet fads - lose all the weight without all the hunger!  All you need is a vial of human blood, a lock of hair from an innocent child, and an evil voodoo curse - it couldn't be easier!

OUTFIT_41_NAME#156.desc_cn: 血液在这里飞溅，血液在那里飞溅 - 乡村杀手愿意调整任何自己的时装长度，好吧，除了那些紧绷的牛仔裤。
OUTFIT_41_NAME#156.desc_en: A blood splatter here, a splash of gore there - the Hillbilly Killer is willing to go to any lengths for his fashion.  Well, except wear skinny jeans.

OUTFIT_42_NAME#157.bonus_cn: 开启神秘圣诞礼物的消耗减半
OUTFIT_42_NAME#157.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Reduces the cost of opening Christmas Mystery Presents by half. (Outfit doesn't need to be equipped)
OUTFIT_42_NAME#157.desc_cn: 当心克劳斯太太 - 圣诞女士来了，她更快，更坏且更厉害！因为她圣诞节将会和以前不同。
OUTFIT_42_NAME#157.desc_en: Watch out Mrs. Claus - the Christmas Gal is here and she's faster, meaner and leaner! Christmas won't be the same with this dynamic gal at the helm!

OUTFIT_43_NAME#158.bonus_cn: 全套奖励：移除摩托车升级所消耗的时间！（套装无需被装备。）
OUTFIT_43_NAME#158.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Remove bike upgrade timers! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_43_NAME#158.desc_cn: 没钱了谁还在乎尊严？当然这很庸俗，而你也许也会对此嗤之以鼻，但那是因为：你太酷了，所以不担心这一点。
OUTFIT_43_NAME#158.desc_en: Who needs modesty if you've got the cash? Sure it's tacky and you'll stick out like a sore thumb but let's face it: you're just too cool to care.

OUTFIT_44_NAME#159.desc_cn: 它丑陋，令人发痒，不合身，但绝对是出于好意制作而成。这就是为什么你会至少戴上它一次。
OUTFIT_44_NAME#159.desc_en: It's ugly, itchy and ill-fitting but was made with nothing but good intentions. And that's why you'll wear it at least once.

OUTFIT_45_NAME#161.desc_cn: 好的装备是比赛的一半，甚至更多。穿上象征胜利的官方KTM骑手装备！
OUTFIT_45_NAME#161.desc_en: Good gear is half the race and it doesn't get much better than this. Dress up for victory with the official KTM riding gear!

OUTFIT_46_NAME#162.desc_cn: 用铁拳、铁叉子或是铁汤匙称霸废区跟排行榜。你是王！你开心就好！
OUTFIT_46_NAME#162.desc_en: Rule the wastes and the leaderboards with an iron fist. Or an iron fork. Or a spoon. You're the king, you decide!

OUTFIT_47_NAME#163.bonus_cn: 在猎宝时候减少2次假赛道的出现 （外套无需装备）
OUTFIT_47_NAME#163.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Reduces the number of decoy tracks in the Treasure Hunt by 2 (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_47_NAME#163.desc_cn: 这是最好的套装让你玩弄那种不是你能控制的力量！
OUTFIT_47_NAME#163.desc_en: Literally the best outfit for meddling with powers you can't possibly comprehend.

OUTFIT_48_NAME#164.desc_cn: 看到那吗？没有？....没错！所以你的对手也看不到！
OUTFIT_48_NAME#164.desc_en: Saw that? No? ...Exactly. Neither will your enemies.

OUTFIT_49_NAME#165.bonus_cn: 完整套装奖励：双倍午夜杯的重试机会。（套装不需要被装备）
OUTFIT_49_NAME#165.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Double retries at the Midnight Circuit. (Outfit doesn't need to be equipped)
OUTFIT_49_NAME#165.desc_cn: 传说，背叛黑帮的人都不会有好的下场。除非你发现那个巨大的髑髅安全帽是最好的躲避方式。
OUTFIT_49_NAME#165.desc_en: Legend has it that betraying the Cartel had dire consequences. Unless you figured out that a giant skull helmet was the perfect way to hide.

OUTFIT_50_NAME#166.desc_cn: 找人吗？以前黑帮的猎人头会是你最好的选择，那天赋可能无法转换，但你看起来能力不错。
OUTFIT_50_NAME#166.desc_en: Looking for someone? The Cartel's Headhunter used to be the best person for the job. The talent may not be transferable, but you do look the part.

OUTFIT_51_NAME#167.desc_cn: 你会觉得你有足够的装备，围巾式多余的，但是在终点线有一个很大的风扇，你会发现围巾的好处。
OUTFIT_51_NAME#167.desc_en: You'd think you were amply covered even without the scarf, but the extra fans at the finish line are going to be worth it!

OUTFIT_52_NAME#168.desc_cn: 不要拼命的去掌握胜利，而是轻松赢得胜利。这是最好沙漠之翼的颜色的代表。
OUTFIT_52_NAME#168.desc_en: Don't just grasp victory, make it dance on your fingertips. Don the official colors of the Desert Wings and rep the best!

OUTFIT_53_NAME#169.desc_cn: 有了这件套装，你会让更多人心碎，你会让很多秀停摆，这真是太疯狂了！但请注意你选的伴侣。
OUTFIT_53_NAME#169.desc_en: With this outfit, you're gonna break so many hearts, you're gonna stop so many shows, it's crazy. Just be careful with your choice of partners.

OUTFIT_54_NAME#220.desc_cn: 骑士夫妇将他们第三个孩子命名为福臭小子，而他好像被宠坏了。现在你能获得他的盔甲。
OUTFIT_54_NAME#220.desc_en: Mr. and Mrs. Knight named their third kid Vengeance. Of course, he was the bully of the family, and now you can have his armor.

OUTFIT_55_NAME#221.bonus_cn: 全套装奖励：在复活节猎蛋中拥有2次免费的提示（套装不需要穿在身上）。
OUTFIT_55_NAME#221.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Have 2 permanent free hints in the Easter Egg Hunt (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_55_NAME#221.desc_cn: 真正的复活节兔子正在外面寻找偷了他的蛋的冒牌货， 他会很迅速执行他的正义，不过你不用担心他知道这只是一套兔子装。
OUTFIT_55_NAME#221.desc_en: The real Easter Bunny is out there and he's looking for the impostor that stole his eggs. His justice will be swift, but don't worry, he knows this is just a costume.

OUTFIT_56_NAME#222.desc_cn: 时尚、美学、风格与经典造型全部都被抛到一边，真是丑陋的集大成者。
OUTFIT_56_NAME#222.desc_en: Fashion, aesthetic sense, style and class, all come together and get flung out the window when you don this ugly ensemble.

OUTFIT_57_NAME#223.bonus_cn: 全套装奖励：在摩托车与火的活动中的每一场比赛一开始就拥有50%的声望。（套装无需被装备。）
OUTFIT_57_NAME#223.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Have 50% extra starting Reputation in every race during the Bikes and Fire Event! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_57_NAME#223.desc_cn: 一位曾经领导叛军对抗腐败军队知名猎人的装扮。很明显的，大家都喜欢跟随一位看不到真面目的人。
OUTFIT_57_NAME#223.desc_en: The garb of a once renowned Hunter who led a rebellion against a corrupt army. Obviously, people flock to follow a face they can't see.

OUTFIT_58_NAME#224.desc_cn: 学学冷静的霓虹双胞胎妹妹的打扮。听说她比姐姐慢 0.5 秒来到这个世界。她对这件事看得很淡。
OUTFIT_58_NAME#224.desc_en: Don the attire of the chilled out younger Neon Twin who is said to have been born 0.5 seconds later. She's pretty chill about it.

OUTFIT_59_NAME#225.desc_cn: 学学鲁莽的霓虹双胞胎姐姐的穿着。你爱怎样就怎样，就是别取笑她的双胞胎妹妹。
OUTFIT_59_NAME#225.desc_en: Dress like the Hot-headed elder Neon Twin. Whatever you do, don't poke fun at her younger sister.

OUTFIT_61_NAME#227.desc_cn: 穿上染着 BMW 官方色彩的服装，看着乡吧佬流口水
OUTFIT_61_NAME#227.desc_en: Wear the official BMW colors and watch the peasants drool.

OUTFIT_62_NAME#160.bonus_cn: 全套装奖励：倍增你的 Rally 赛票总张数！（可不穿上套装。）
OUTFIT_62_NAME#160.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Double your total Rally Tickets! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_62_NAME#160.desc_cn: 打扮成历史上首位留下记录的骑士模样。传说这首位骑士也造就了史上第一次摔车纪录。绷带就是这么来的。
OUTFIT_62_NAME#160.desc_en: Adorn the look of the first ever historically recorded biker. Legend has it, the first biker also had the first bike crash. Hence the bandages.

OUTFIT_63_NAME#228.bonus_cn: 完整套装奖励：进行把爱传出去活动时可获得 50% 额外起始爱情（不用穿上套装）。
OUTFIT_63_NAME#228.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: 50% bonus starting love when playing the Love Express Event (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_63_NAME#228.desc_cn: 时髦的泰德想把爱传遍整个 Frontier！做他那样的打扮，赢得人心和奖章！
OUTFIT_63_NAME#228.desc_en: Ted the hipster wants to spread love across the frontier! Dress up like him and win hearts along with your medals!

OUTFIT_64_NAME#229.desc_cn: 对猫女而言，破坏轮胎和创纪录再简单不过！皮带对她来讲多多益善！爪子也是！
OUTFIT_64_NAME#229.desc_en: Ripping tires and records comes easy to this feline lady, who always has space for more belts! Claws included.

OUTFIT_65_NAME#237.desc_cn: 无畏寒冷天候的冰雪骑士喜欢在雪地里竞速！请看他大展身手，但别在家里学他耍特技！
OUTFIT_65_NAME#237.desc_en: Immune to cold weather, Sno-rider loves racing in the snow! Watch him go, but don't try his stunts at home!

OUTFIT_66_NAME#238.bonus_cn: 全套装奖励：你的总 X-赛票数加倍（可不穿上套装）。
OUTFIT_66_NAME#238.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Double your total X-Tickets! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_66_NAME#238.desc_cn: 「车轮」将特技带向全新境界！给他任何有车轮的玩意儿，他就能在墙壁、公园、板凳...任何你说得出来的地方...骑着跑！
OUTFIT_66_NAME#238.desc_en: 'Wheels' takes Stunts to a whole new level! Give him anything with wheels on them, and he'd be riding it on walls, parks, benches .. you name it!

OUTFIT_67_NAME#239.desc_cn: 交出你的枪、交出你的马！副警长四处巡啊巡、逮住警长漏掉的所有匪徒！
OUTFIT_67_NAME#239.desc_en: Give up your guns, and give up your horses! The Deputy is ridin' 'round town to catch all the goons the Sheriff couldn't!

OUTFIT_68_NAME#240.bonus_cn: 获得万圣节寻猎的 2 个永久免费提示。
OUTFIT_68_NAME#240.bonus_en: Have 2 permanent free hints in the Halloween Hunt.
OUTFIT_68_NAME#240.desc_cn: 疯狂科学怪人最喜欢的恶梦包括被摩托车声惊醒、弄断他的锁链，以及在暗夜中骑车！
OUTFIT_68_NAME#240.desc_en: Nutjob Frank's favorite nightmare includes waking up to the sound of a bike, breaking his chains, and riding away into the night!

OUTFIT_69_NAME#241.desc_cn: 极速跑者热爱速度。给他一条赛道，他会在上头呼啸而过。给他一辆摩托车，他会在身后留下一道火光照亮赛道！
OUTFIT_69_NAME#241.desc_en: The Speedrunner likes speed. Give him a track, and he'll blaze through it. Give him a bike, and he'll light the Track on fire!

OUTFIT_70_NAME#242.bonus_cn: 完整套装奖励：加倍你的假期赛票总数！（可不穿上套装）
OUTFIT_70_NAME#242.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Double your total Holiday Tickets! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_70_NAME#242.desc_cn:
别惹恶霸老人，否则他会把你的礼物、你的槲寄生，还有你的圣诞装饰拿回家！
给他尝点用混了苦味面糊的蜜糖蛋糕，他就会陪你骑车到跨年夜！
OUTFIT_70_NAME#242.desc_en:
Don't mess with Bad Bone Sr., or he'll take home your gifts, your mistletoes, and your Christmas decorations!
Treat him with a sweet, sugary cake mixed with a bitter batter, and he'll be riding with you until New Year's Eve!

OUTFIT_71_NAME#243.cn: 特技车手 Antti 套装
OUTFIT_71_NAME#243.desc_cn: 化身成出席 E3 2018 的 Antti，告诉世人没有任何障碍能够阻挡你！但请小心别摔断太多根骨头！
OUTFIT_71_NAME#243.desc_en: Ride as Antti at E3 2018 and show that no obstacle is too tough for you! Just try not to break too many bones!

OUTFIT_72_NAME#244.desc_cn: 崛起疾行吧！这名骑士不知道什么叫做停下来！他和世界各地的传奇好手比赛并赢得许多奖牌…现在他来到了 Frontier！
OUTFIT_72_NAME#244.desc_en: Rise up and Ride! This rider doesn’t know how to stop! He's raced with legends and won medals worldwide… and now he's in the Frontier!

OUTFIT_73_NAME#245.bonus_cn: 获得「欧贝的任务」的 2 个永久免费提示。
OUTFIT_73_NAME#245.bonus_en: Get 2 permanent free hints in Orbie's Quest.
OUTFIT_73_NAME#245.desc_cn: 这位探险者因为热爱星际旅行而在太空中跑透透！由于宇宙飞船坠落而被困在 Frontier 的欧贝需要你帮助才能返回欧巴克斯星球！
OUTFIT_73_NAME#245.desc_en: An explorer who travels across the universe for the sole love of intergalactic travel! Alienated in the Frontier because of a space-shipwreck, 'Orbie' needs your help to get back to Planet Orbax!

OUTFIT_74_NAME#246.bonus_cn: 全套装奖励：倍增你的 Rally 赛票总张数！（可不穿上套装。）
OUTFIT_74_NAME#246.bonus_en: Full outfit bonus: Double your total Rally Tickets! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_74_NAME#246.desc_cn: 你最好慢下来，否则沥青铺设机会让你灰头土脸...浑身是沥青！
OUTFIT_74_NAME#246.desc_en: You'd better slow down or the Asphalt Feeder will serve you an awful concoction of smoke, dust, and… well, asphalt!

OUTFIT_75_NAME#256.bonus_cn: 使火箭推进器的充填时间减少 50% 在 大跃进（不用穿上套装）。
OUTFIT_75_NAME#256.bonus_en: Reduce the rocket thruster recharge time by 50% in Giant Leaps (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_75_NAME#256.desc_en: Ensures your survival on the Moon!

OUTFIT_76_NAME#257.bonus_cn: 倍增你的特技票券总张数！（可不穿上套装）
OUTFIT_76_NAME#257.bonus_en: Double your total Stunt tickets! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_76_NAME#257.desc_cn: 「丛林探险者」总是准备好在 Frontier 各地面对新挑战与新特技！称霸丛林、称冠排行榜！
OUTFIT_76_NAME#257.desc_en: Jungle Explorer is always ready for new challenges and stunts across the frontier! Rule the Jungle and rule the leaderboards!

OUTFIT_77_NAME#258.bonus_cn: 在万圣节狂热中拥有2次永久免费提示。
OUTFIT_77_NAME#258.bonus_en: Have 2 permanent free hints in the Halloween Heat.
OUTFIT_77_NAME#258.desc_cn: 古尔博士渴望扭力！这个吸血鬼不想喝血，他以对手的连胜为食！
OUTFIT_77_NAME#258.desc_en: Dr. Cuul has a thirst for torque! This vampire doesn't want blood, it feeds on the opponents' win streak!

OUTFIT_78_NAME#259.bonus_cn: 倍增你的特技票券总张数！（可不穿上套装）
OUTFIT_78_NAME#259.bonus_en: Double your total Stunt tickets! (Outfit does not need to be equipped.)
OUTFIT_78_NAME#259.desc_cn: 你听说过「书架上的小精灵」，现在准备好让小精灵飞奔啦！
OUTFIT_78_NAME#259.desc_en: You've heard of Elf on the Shelf, now get ready for Elf on the run!
